claims.incremental: FORGE LP value (liquidity + idle fees + premium paid) >= plain Orca LP value (liquidity + fees) for the same capital, ladder and price path; extra = B - A.
claims.absolute: LP value vs holding the starting tokens (HODL) and vs plain Orca LP, at the window end.

not_a_replay: Binance bars drive a simulated pool (arbitrage to each price, optional noise volume); not a replay of Orca swaps. Borrow demand and budgets are assumptions swept below.
lpsim_deviations: Time-floor notional of a call (borrowed base) is valued at the open reference price, as strategy_open.rs stores notional_quote; lpsim values it at the close price.
Keeper trigger modeled (budgets *+keeper): anyone may close once accrued premium >= 80% of the LP cap (keeper_trigger_bps = 8000); lpsim never closes early.

Restoration guard: besides lpsim's buffer-vs-cost test, a restoration whose swap cost exceeds swap_slippage_bps (50) is refused and retried after 1 h with the liquidity still out of the pool and premium still accruing (the program's Recovery path); lpsim only counts the failure.
Borrow utilization is fixed per demand level (0.2 / 0.5 / 0.8) instead of uniform(0.2, 0.8), and open/hold rates are set by the demand sweep instead of open_prob / mean_hold_steps.
Fee model 'arb-band' (no-arbitrage band) added; lpsim's model ('arb') charges the fee on every move.

Noise volume is scaled to the ladder's actual starting value. lpsim's lp_notional is sum(L (sqrt p_b - sqrt p_a)) x sqrt(P0), i.e. sqrt(P0) times the ladder's value, so Benchmark 3's 'base+noise' carries ~10x the stated noise volume on SOL/USDC (sqrt(73) ~ 8.6 at the GBM start, ~11 on 2026 history) and ~0.5x on JUP/USDC.

budgets.funded: every borrower funds 100% of notional (cap never binds)
budgets.realistic: Benchmark 3 base: 90% fund max(3x expected floor, 1% of notional), 10% fund 0.5x expected floor; no keeper, every borrow runs its full hold
budgets.realistic+keeper: as realistic, but a keeper closes the position 5 min after accrued premium reaches 80% of the cap (the on-chain trigger)
budgets.min: adversarial: every borrower funds the on-chain minimum (1 USDC atom); no keeper ever closes
budgets.min+keeper: adversarial minimum budget, with a keeper closing 5 min after the 80% trigger
